newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stocks up two pct, index at year's high.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stocks up two pct, index at year's high.

text.p: The Bahrain Stock Exchange share index climbed 34.75 points -- or two percent -- in the week to Thursday in moderate turnover, official figures showed.
The exchange said the index climbed the 1,664.60 points, the highest level this year, from 1,629.85 points the previous week.
More than 10.8 million shares worth two million dinars ($5.3 million) were traded in the week, down from 12.3 million shares worth 2.26 million dinars a week earlier.
Shares of 23 of the 40 listed firms changed hands in 315 transactions.
Bahrain Middle East Bank continued to lead trade with more than 2.36 million shares worth 328,125 dinars traded. The shares closed on Thursday two fils higher at 140 fils.
The bourse said 1.76 million shares of Bahrain Commercial Facilities Company worth 354,879 dinars were traded. The share price ended 19 fils higher at 208 fils.
Investcorp shares gained 12 U.S. cents to close on Thursday at $1.98 each and Bahrain International Bank climbed one fils to 184 fils each.
